title: Preview shows every follow-up, acknowledgement inactive, no banner
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with 'Settings - Service' enabled, on the build under test (template authoring).
  • A template draft with a checkbox field carrying configured follow-ups and an attached file, open in Preview mode.
custom_steps:
1. Switch to Preview (it mounts the fill screen, so no response can be given) and confirm every configured follow-up on a field is shown at once, each naming the response it belongs to.
2. Confirm the attached file still opens in Preview (opening a file is a read), and the acknowledgement appears in the same inert, non-interactive style Preview uses for the verdict controls and takes no input.
3. Confirm Preview draws no banner explaining itself.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Preview mounts the fill screen so no response can be given, so every configured follow-up on a field is shown at once, each naming the response it belongs to.
  • The file still opens in Preview (a read), and the acknowledgement renders in the inert treatment the verdict controls use there and takes no input.
  • Preview draws no banner explaining itself.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-10243 (S19 — Conditional follow-up on a checkbox response); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S19; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S19-R27: “Preview mounts the fill screen, so no response can be given. Every configured follow-up on a field will therefore be shown at once, each naming the response it belongs to”
  • S19-R28: “The file will still open in Preview, because that is a read. The acknowledgement will render in the inert treatment the verdict controls already use there and will take no input, per S12-R31”
  • S19-R29: “Preview will draw no banner explaining itself”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
